items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: I played with the Tarny Tribe band. It was by Professor Pritchett. He had a band around in the District 4th of War, about 39 or 40.

ctx.x: Yeah. Can you tell us anything about the first bands you ever played in? Did you ever play with anybody with your guitar before you took up sax? Did you ever hit bands or anything else?

Well, I played in quite a number of bands around, but I played like the Tuxedo band. I played with them. Like I tell you, I played with the Yara band. I played with the Tarny Tribe band. It was by Professor Pritchett. He had a band around in the District 4th of War, about 39 or 40. What was your very first job?
Do you remember what that was?
